name: Short vowel (CVC)
description: Simple consonant-vowel-consonant words with a short vowel

name: High-frequency sight word
description: Common words learned by sight, often irregular

name: Two-letter blend
description: Two consonants blended at the start of a word

name: Three-letter blend
description: Three consonants blended (str, spr, scr, thr)

name: Digraph th
description: Two letters making one sound /th/

name: Digraph sh
description: Two letters making one sound /sh/

name: Digraph ch
description: Two letters making one sound /ch/

name: Ending ng
description: Words ending in the /ng/ sound

name: Suffix -ing
description: Words with the -ing ending

name: Suffix -ed
description: Past tense -ed ending (/t/, /d/, /id/)

name: Vowel team
description: Two vowels making one sound (ai, ay, ee, ea, oa, oo)

name: ou / ough / ow
description: Tricky vowel spellings

name: R-controlled vowel
description: Vowel followed by r (ar, er, ir, or, ur)

name: Silent (magic) e
description: Long vowel made by a final silent e

name: Multisyllable word
description: Words with three or more syllables

name: Simple syllables (KP)
description: Words made of simple consonant-vowel syllables

name: Madalas na salita (sight word)
description: Very common short function words

name: Digraph ng
description: The ng sound as one letter (ng, nga, ngi)

name: Salitang mga
description: Special spelling: mga is read 'manga'

name: Diphthong (ay, aw, iy, uy, oy)
description: Two vowel sounds glided together

name: Consonant cluster (kambal-katinig)
description: Two consonants together, often in loanwords

name: Affixed word (panlapi)
description: Words with prefixes or infixes such as nag-, mag-, -um-, -in-

name: Long word (4+ syllables)
description: Long words, reduplicated or hyphenated words
